  • GitRbit/rbit

    Blazing fast, self-hosted Git hosting written in Rust. Developed here in the open; also on GitHub at github.com/GitRbit/rbit.

    12 hours ago

  • One fast binary

    SQLite and an embedded store. No other services to install or run.

  • Git over HTTPS and SSH

    Smart HTTP with protocol v2, a built-in SSH server and deploy keys.

  • Organizations and teams

    Share repositories with teams and collaborators, role by role.

  • Releases, mirrors and webhooks

    Publish releases, mirror upstream projects and notify other services.

  • Secure by default

    Two-factor sign-in, scoped access tokens and an audit log.

  • On every screen

    Responsive down to phone size and installable as an app.
